title: Stage VM backup knowledge and ADR decisions as raw JSONL through ops
scope: ops proposal for VM backup, Windows host recovery automation, ADR raw JSONL decision, and scope-closure controls
non_goals: store backup tar.gz artifacts in git
treat ops staging as final canonical policy/adrs/evidence ownership

decision: ADR-like decisions produced by the VM backup and Windows recovery stream must be recorded as raw JSONL records, not Markdown, before they are promoted to adrs.git or other canonical stores.
rationale: The active user correction explicitly disallowed Markdown saves for this stream and required raw JSONL append records.
JSONL preserves machine-checkable parse gates, duplicate-id checks, append-only auditability, and agent readback boundaries.
The work involves Gen0/Gen1/Gen2 authority, sensitive capture gates, and rollback/suspension records; these need structured status and supersession fields rather than prose-only ADRs.
For corporate-sale readiness, due-diligence evidence needs clear distinction between plan, execution, validation, caveat, suspension, and adoption state.
promotion_gate: Only raw JSONL records that parse cleanly and carry explicit status may be proposed for adrs.git promotion.

facts: Windows host was used as temporary backup storage for NixOS VM recovery work.
Whole /home archive was rejected as default after timeout and because Windows extraction is not a valid preservation proof for Nix-origin data.
A metadata-verified archive for ~/work and ~/bin exists outside git as data-inbox/p0-work-bin-20260620-163341.tar.gz in the Windows vm worktree.
Sensitive paths such as ~/.secret, ~/.codex, ~/.git, and source repositories remain gated until storage custody is decided.
~/repos inventory was later suspended as forward-planning evidence because scope was not sufficiently closed to the top objective before execution.
lessons: Operational scripts belong naturally in ops, but policy, ADR, and evidence records should remain explicitly typed for later promotion or split.
OS-name repositories such as windows are useful for host-local automation but too broad to act as corporate-sale SSOT by themselves.
Before inventory or capture, Gen0 must record why the action is inside the VM responsibility boundary and how it serves the top objective.

decision: Stage all non-artifact VM backup knowledge in ops first, with explicit future_home classification, while excluding secrets and binary backup artifacts from git.

classification.record_family: PowerShell scripts and scheduled task design
operational runbooks and restore proof design

denied_storage: content captures not explicitly approved by Gen0

checks: proposal file is raw JSONL only
no Markdown file is introduced by this proposal
no backup artifact or secret is added to git
future_home is explicit before promotion out of ops staging
scope-closure gate is recorded before any further VM inventory or capture
recommended_next_action: Open or transport this ops proposal for review before promoting any ADR records to adrs.git.
